[[XL Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 UConn Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Connecticut]] in the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies were led by fifth-year head coach [[Kevin Ollie]]. The Huskies split their home games between the [[XL Center]] in [[Hartford, Connecticut]], and the [[Harry A. Gampel Pavilion]] on the UConn campus in [[Storrs, Connecticut]]. The Huskies were members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. UConn finished the season 16–17, 9–9 in [[2016–17 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2016–17 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]] and [[2016–17 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] to advance to the semifinals of the [[2017 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] where they lost to [[2016–17 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]]. == Previous season == The [[2015–16 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 25–11, 11–7 in [[2014–15 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in sixth place. The Huskies won the [[2016 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] as the fifth seed, defeating [[2015–16 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] and Temple to reach the championship game. They defeated [[2015–16 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]] in the championship.{{cite web|title=UConn Downs Memphis 72-58 to take AAC Championship|url=http://www.uconnhuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/031316aab.html|website=UConnHuskies.com|access-date=14 June 2016}}{{cite web|title=Adams Sparks UConn in Win Over Cincinnati, 104-97|url=http://www.uconnhuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/031116aaa.html|website=UConnHuskies.com|access-date=14 June 2016}} The Huskies received a No. 9 seed in the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and defeated No. 8 seed [[2015–16 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]] in the First Round before losing to No. 1 seed [[2015–16 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the Second Round.{{cite web|title=No. 9 UConn Falls to No. 1 Kansas 73-61 in Second Round|url=http://www.uconnhuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/031916aaa.html|website=UConnHuskies.com|access-date=14 June 2016}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
